Game Overview

In Asteroins, the core idea is straightforward: guide a tiny alien through a meteor-infested sky in Asteroins. Master intuitive controls to deftly dodge cosmic debris and survive the escalating chaos. With each second, the challenge intensifies, demanding quick reflexes and strategic movements. Can you outlast the relentless meteor shower and claim your cosmic victory?
